
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# tag -> world -> item count, from the bank (world items only), so the browser knows what exists per skill
rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Filter(function(x) grepl("^w[0-9]+$", x$world), ITEMS),
                              function(x) data.frame(tag = x$tags, world = x$world)))
tm <- lapply(split(rows, rows$tag), function(d) as.list(table(d$world)))
cat("\n```{=html}\n<script>window.RQ_TAGMAP=", jsonlite::toJSON(tm, auto_unbox = TRUE), ";</script>\n```\n", sep = "")
```

::: {.rq-lesson}
Your progress lives in this browser. Skills are earned by solving items without hints: the tree shows where you stand, the recommender picks the next skill, and anything you have not used for 30 days is queued for review.
:::
